Package data

Class MockDataStore

java.lang.Object
data.MockDataStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
DataStore
public class MockDataStore extends Object implements DataStore
In-memory sample data so the GUI runs without the database. Employees and menu match the seed data in squad_21_db. Every PIN is 1234.

    • getInventoryUsage

      public List<InventoryUsage> getInventoryUsage(LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      Description copied from interface: DataStore
      How much of each inventory item sales used, for the Inventory Usage report. Refunded sales count too: the drink was already made, so its ingredients and supplies are gone either way. Usage for an inventory row is quantity sold times servings_used; rows for the same item (same name, category and unit) are added together.
      Specified by:
      getInventoryUsage in interface DataStore
      Parameters:
      from - the first day, inclusive
      to - the last day, inclusive
      Returns:
      one row per inventory item, most used first

    • useStock

      private void useStock(List<MockDataStore.SaleLine> lines)
      Lowers On Hand for the inventory each line uses. Sample servings are fractions of a bulk unit (0.02 of a sleeve of cups), so whole units come off as the fractions add up.
      Parameters:
      lines - the lines of a sale that was just saved
